snippet.title: Anomalien // Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3852260/Anomalien/

You’re a retired lab worker sent to Tulega City, chasing UFOs. Only with a prototype scanner, hunt anomalies, weaken them, and stop the source from spreading before it’s too late.

Developed by
Null Roo
